screens: D-pad moves between categories and player controls. CROSS opens or activates. SQUARE opens Now Playing.
Up/Down selects. CROSS opens a group or plays a track. CIRCLE returns. TRIANGLE opens a contextual action where available.
D-pad moves focus or opens shortcuts. CROSS activates. START plays or pauses. Tap L/R to change track; hold to seek. TRIANGLE opens Spectrum. SQUARE opens Cassette.
Left/Right changes palette. Tap L/R to change track. CIRCLE or TRIANGLE returns to Now Playing. SQUARE opens Cassette.
Open Track Information from the Information screen. Left/Right or L/R changes page. Up/Down scrolls. CIRCLE returns.
Left/Right changes color. START or CROSS plays or pauses. CIRCLE or SQUARE returns to Now Playing.
SELECT opens About. HOME opens the PSP exit dialog. Pause playback, return to Library, and hold TRIANGLE for Diagnostics.
